subject: BluejayTech - Identity Operations & Delegated Admins Deep-dive
messages:
From: Derek Hsu <derek.hsu@bluejaytech.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Oct 2028 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RFP identity follow-ups — delegated admin / SCIM samples

Hi Sean / Kimberly,

Thanks for the initial RFP packet — the executive summary was helpful. As we prepare the security and operations track for Bluejay's platform evaluation, the identity team has a handful of technical clarifications we need before the 10/12 procurement review: 

1) SCIM provisioning: do you support full bulk user import (initial seed) and delta-only SCIM v2 syncs thereafter? If delta-only, how do you communicate large deletes or historical merges?
2) SCIM payloads: can you provide a representative SCIM bulk import JSON (sample user + multi-group assignment)? We will use it to validate our attribute mapping scripts.
3) Delegated admin and RBAC model: describe how delegated admin scopes are represented in your console and via APIs. Do delegated admins have a separate audit trail and can their actions be restricted to a set of tenant namespaces?
4) Cross-tenant admin: do you support read-only cross-tenant viewers for managed-service partners? What controls prevent accidental privilege elevation?
5) SSO and session controls: what session lifetime and step-up MFA policies are enforced at the platform level vs. left to customer IdP policy?
6) Audit retention: how long are admin actions, SCIM sync logs, and SSO assertions retained by default? Can retention be extended for customers with specific compliance needs?

If possible, could you attach the sample SCIM JSON and a short delegated-admin matrix that maps UI roles to API scopes? Also let us know the day/time your team can demo the admin console with a focus on delegated admin workflows.

Best,
Derek
Bluejay Technologies

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Oct 2028 11:35:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: RFP identity follow-ups — delegated admin / SCIM samples

Sean / Marissa — draft responses below (I will attach the sample JSON and retention tables in the package):

- SCIM provisioning: Redwood supports both an initial bulk import and subsequent delta-only SCIM v2 syncs. For initial seeds we recommend a single bulk import job via our SCIM bulk endpoint that accepts an array of User/Group objects (see attached "bluejay-scim-sample.json"). Delta syncs are delivered as incremental PATCH operations; large deletes are expressed as delete PATCHes with a tombstone attribute and preserved in the sync log for 30 days to allow reconciliation. For particularly large historical merges we support a one-time server-side reconciliation job (scheduled with our Onboarding team) to apply merge rules.

- SCIM payload example: attached JSON shows: user core attributes (userName, externalId), emails[], name, active flag, groups (with externalId), and custom enterprise extension for role_bindings. We include a second example for nested group membership.

- Delegated admin & RBAC: our model has three layers — Organization Admin (global), Tenant Admin (tenant-scoped), and Role Admin (delegated). Delegated admin roles are expressed as policy objects that map to API scopes (e.g., tenants:read, tenants:users:update, tenants:roles:assign). The console exposes a Delegated Admin UI where role assignments are bounded to tenant namespaces; the API supports the same scoping via a tenant_id parameter. Actions taken by delegated admins are recorded in a separate admin_audit stream so they can be filtered independently from global admin events.

- Cross-tenant viewers: we support read-only cross-tenant viewers for partners. These are explicit opt-ins per customer and require both SAML trust and an identity mapping. Elevation controls: any write-capable action triggers an immediate step-up MFA requirement and an approval workflow.

- SSO & session controls: session lifetime is configurable per customer by default (90 days token lifetime with refresh token rotation every 7 days). We enforce step-up policies for privilege elevation at the platform level (MFA required) but leave primary authentication (password + primary MFA) to the customer's IdP. We support SAML assertions, OIDC id_token exchange, and attribute-based session policies (e.g., restrict session when IP/geolocation changes).

- Audit retention: admin actions and admin_audit stream retained 365 days by default; SCIM sync logs and SSO assertion logs retained 180 days. We offer extended retention (3-7 years) as an enterprise add-on and can provide exportable audit packages for customer archiving.

I'll attach the sample files and a short matrix that maps the UI role names to API scopes. I also propose a 30-minute demo on Tue 10/9 14:00 PT — Marissa, can you lock that in?

Thanks,
Kimberly
Director, Identity & Access Controls
Redwood Inference
